About

I'm a videographer and photographer based in Northern Virginia and Miami. My past experience includes working with the videography team at Zion Springs, creating a project for On Running, and taking on smaller freelance jobs.

These days, I'm continuing to build my freelance work while looking for new opportunities to create strong, honest visual stories.
